question: Which state's governor approved the Prohibition of Online Gaming and Regulation of Online Games Bill 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Online Gaming and Regulation of Online Games Bill 2022:-**

 
 
• **The state whose governor approved the Prohibition of Online Gaming and Regulation of Online Games Bill 2022 is Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **The bill aims to ban online games that involve betting, wagering, or gambling in any form.**
 
• The bill also proposes to establish a regulatory body to oversee online gaming and ensure compliance with the law.
 
• The decision to pass the bill was taken after concerns were raised about the negative impact of online gaming on youth and vulnerable sections of society.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh: **

 
 
• The state government issued an ordinance in September 2020 to ban online gaming and betting, citing concerns about the rise in gambling addiction and related crimes.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat:**
 
 
• The state government passed a law in 2017 banning online gaming and gambling, including skill-based games such as poker and rummy.
 
 
 
• **Punjab:**
 
 
• The state government has not taken any specific action to ban online gaming, but there have been reports of police crackdowns on illegal gambling activities, including online betting.
